# Pitex 1.0.1

This release fixes how Markdown files look in the macOS editor.

## Changes

- macOS: Markdown files now show the editor theme's text color as soon as they open.
  Before, the existing text appeared in the system default color (white in dark mode)
  and only newly typed text used the theme color.

## Install

Pitex 1.0.0 updates to 1.0.1 from Settings or, with automatic installation on, at launch.
Builds from the earlier 2.x line do not update automatically; install 1.0.1 from the
downloads below (with Homebrew, run `brew update` and then `brew upgrade --cask pitex`).

## Downloads

Downloads include the macOS ARM64 DMG, Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 AMD64 DEBs,
Windows AMD64 installer and portable ZIP, the Ubuntu installer, and SHA256SUMS.
Windows remains beta.
